rows.approvedTreatment: Preserve descriptive comfort choices, but use compelling room visuals and distinct real choices; remove cutesy type labels and repetitive mood prompts.
Build a coherent original story with meaningful contributions. Role-card compliance alone is insufficient payoff.
Select surprising species-specific evidence and actual myth contrasts; avoid eight generic true/false claims or a study-protocol exam.
Promising history/evidence hook; choose fascinating documented objects and reveal what each source can establish. Abstract evidence classification alone still needs substance.
Replace fictional serving arithmetic with researched Halloween food history or packaging surprises; use distinct facts rather than repeating one tradition.
Keep the substantive editing/misdirection premise. Each task must expose a different inference or reveal.
Use real sound-story craft and an engaging original broadcast arc; avoid another arbitrary numeric cue key.
Replace fixed-offset conversion with documented place/tradition/filming-location relationships. Keep genuine geographic substance.
Rebuild for meaningful game choices and a satisfying outcome. Original rules are allowed; repeated legal-play lookup is the weak part.
Use precise, enjoyable verbal clues with a clear reveal; avoid abstract relation-key copying.
Stronger preference premise. Retain meaningful tradeoffs and descriptive results, with no diagnosis or fake moral ranking.
Replace count/exclusion drills with a coherent character-and-event mystery or collaborative story payoff.
Use specific eerie natural phenomena with supported explanations and observable distinctions. Avoid Latin-name memorization or presenting old events as current.
Strong potential: a documented telling that unfolds across fragments. Avoid eight paraphrases of the same source-literacy rule.
Replace candy stock arithmetic with distinct researched food/celebration facts or genuine taste choices.
Keep meaningful visual light/shadow craft; use actual authored diagrams that support the questions, rather than numeric substitutes.
Make the auditory contrast itself worth hearing and answerable in text. Do not invent universal perception or hearing claims.
Replace coordinate/closed-edge drills with geographic discovery, a real place-based source trail, or a coherent non-numeric map mystery.
Rebuild around an engaging game or social decision. A seasonal noun on bracket advancement is insufficient.
Replace symbolic weights and bins with a verbal, visual or evidence-based puzzle that earns its Halloween premise.
Stronger human-agency premise. Use credible costume dilemmas and descriptive responses rather than caricatured types.
Rebuild for social meaning or a coherent mystery; more exclusion matching alone repeats the current weakness.
Use specific NASA objects/images or dated observations. Verify current timing/location and avoid calling expired events tonight.
Strong archival-discovery premise if original descriptions and verified metadata yield surprising stories; inspect item rights before any image reuse.
Replace serving arithmetic with researched Halloween food customs, sensory choices or interesting preparation history; no health claims.
Keep stop-motion craft but show meaningful frame/story changes. Avoid returning to frame-rate calculations.
Keep audible meter recognition and original audio/text equivalents; avoid frequency-ratio mathematics disguised as music.
Replace fence/perimeter geometry with a genuinely geographic seasonal premise.
Rebuild the sports/game premise around judgment, visual play or a coherent puzzle. Repeated fictional score audits are insufficient.
Keep verbal inference if clues are distinct and yield a real solution; avoid interchangeable supplied-rule exercises.
Stronger value/preferences premise. Make choices consequential and nuanced; no moral ranking or psychometric claim.
Rebuild the social experience beyond compatibility edges. Human motivations and a satisfying outcome must matter.
Strong natural-history potential with precise botanical facts and original diagrams. Avoid unsupported species keys.
Strong potential for revealing how a folklore claim changed across records. Do not reduce every item to the same quote-versus-inference label.
Replace budget/stock optimization with a distinct seasonal food premise or meaningful social choice.
Keep the film vocabulary/storyboard premise if the visual clue and resulting storytelling choice are interesting.
Keep sound-palette preferences and accessible original audio; require distinct sonic choices and descriptive results.
Replace fictional date-line conversions with documented geographic discovery or a non-numeric place-based mystery.
Rebuild the escape concept so discovery and choices carry the game. Action-point arithmetic is not enough.
A coherent ghost mystery or rich verbal puzzle is promising; a bare truth-table key with a seasonal title is not.
